                                  13          The Court set a pre-trial conference for April 1, 2026, with a deadline to file pre-trial

                                  14   materials by March 18, 2026. ECF No. 25; see Standing Order for Civil Jury Trials, Section B.

                                  15   The parties failed to file any pre-trial materials by the deadline and, aside from a notice of

                                  16   appearance, have not filed anything in this case since April 22, 2025. See ECF No. 22.

                                  17          The Court VACATES the April 1, 2026 pre-trial conference. The parties are ordered to

                                  18   show cause why they did not timely comply with Court pre-trial deadlines, and why this case

                                  19   should not be dismissed for failure to prosecute. See Federal Rules of Civil Procedure 41(b),

                                  20   16(f). If a party opposes the order to show cause, by no later than March 25, 2026, the party must

                                  21   file an opposition of no more than 3 pages and serve it on the opposing party. A hearing on the

                                  22   order to show cause is set for Wednesday, April 1, 2026, at 2:00 p.m. in Courtroom 3, 5th Floor,

                                  23   Federal Courthouse, 280 South First Street, San Jose, California. The parties must appear at the

                                  24   hearing in person; no remote appearances are permitted.

                                  25          IT IS SO ORDERED.

                                  26   Dated: March 23, 2026

                                                                                                     Noël Wise
